=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh:502-572 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: resolve_ci_reissue_base_branch treats a 404 on the merged PR's base branch as a fatal `branch_missing` refusal (exit 3). Finalize deletes integration branches (`gh pr merge "${final_pr}" ... --squash --delete-branch` at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh line 14436), so a later unblock-judge re-issue fails permanently, and .github/workflows/plan.yml lines 448-450 (and the matching paths in clarify.yml/implement.yml/validate.yml/orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml) turn rc 3 into `exit 1`, instead of planning on the default branch, which now holds the merged code.
  WHY: Re-issues often resolve after the project has finalized, so every plan/clarify/implement/validate retry fails the same way and files another heal report, with no automated recovery. All reviewers rated it MAJOR; confidence was 3-4. Suggested fixes: on a confirmed 404, emit a `::notice::` (`outcome=skipped reason=base_branch_deleted`) and return 0 with empty stdout to keep the default branch, keeping `branch_lookup_failed` for non-404 errors; or follow the deleted branch to its merged PR's base, as scripts/retarget_merged_base.sh does. Either way, update reissue_merged_pr_base_branch_missing_refuses.json and the changelog.
- changelog.d/ci-reissue-merged-pr-base-branch-routing.md:13 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The documented operator remedy, "add an `Integration branch:` line to the re-issue, to unblock it", does not work. A `reissue <pr>` verdict dispatches straight to resolve_ci_reissue_base_branch (resolve_integration_ref.sh:441-445) and never reaches the `extract_integration_branch` path (resolve_integration_ref.sh:637-648). The parser's reissue shape check (resolve_integration_ref.sh:239-246) also does not exclude bodies that carry an `Integration branch:` line.
  WHY: An operator who follows the changelog remedy still gets exit 1 with `reason=branch_missing` on the next plan run, so the documented escape hatch does nothing (source severity MAJOR).
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:330-344 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan.yml comment says `"routed" means the branch is a verified PR head from CI-triage routing`. That is now stale, because the reissue path logs the same `outcome=routed` literal for a merged PR's base branch.
  WHY: Nothing breaks today, because the check-triage guard (plan.yml lines 1906-1917 / 1902-1916) only acts on `ai:check-triage`-labelled issues and reissues carry no label. The risk is that a future consumer trusts the documented PR-head meaning (source severity NIT). Minimal fix: update the comment on lines 331-333.
- scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh:487-570 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The log message `CI_TRIAGE_PR_BRANCH_ROUTING ... outcome=routed branch=${ref}` is shared by the verify path (lines 487/491) and the reissue path (lines 558, 566, 569-570), so one literal now covers two meanings: a verified PR head and a merged PR's base branch.
  WHY: This is semantic drift. A future consumer could treat an unverified integration branch tip as a verified PR head, and post-hoc log analysis can no longer tell which path produced the route (source severity NIT).
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:254-432 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `urllib.request.urlopen()` in the fetch() of the generated solc_install.py (lines 307-313) follows redirects before the final-hostname check runs. A redirect off binaries.soliditylang.org is therefore contacted and read before it is rejected.
  WHY: The sha256 check still protects integrity and the build still fails, but the restriction to the allowed host is only enforced after another host has been contacted (source severity NIT; confidence 2-4). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised this only as hardening suggestions. Fix: an HTTPRedirectHandler that rejects redirects to non-`https://binaries.soliditylang.org/` targets (6-8 lines).
- scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh:557 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The 404 classification `grep -Eq 'status=404|HTTP 404|Not Found'` on the branch-read stderr classifies any non-404 error whose text contains "Not Found" as `branch_missing` instead of `branch_lookup_failed`.
  WHY: Operators are pointed at the wrong remedy, though the exit-3 outcome is the same either way (source severity NIT). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised this only as a hardening suggestion. Fix: drop `|Not Found`, or prefer `[ "${GH_API_RETRY_LAST_STATUS:-}" = "404" ]` as branch_exists() does at line 101.
- scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh:506-512 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `if [ "${pr_rc}" -ne 0 ]` check after `_resolver_rate_limited "pr-${pr}"` is unreachable when pr_rc==75, because that helper (line 21) exits the shell. The same dead code appears at lines 550-561.
  WHY: This causes no runtime failure. It is intentional defensive duplication that matches the verify-path pattern (source severity NIT).
- scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh:236-249 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A label-less body with a `<!-- check-failure-triage:pr=` marker that does not match the full unblock-judge shape is parsed as `skip` and sent down the legacy default-branch path. The verify path (line 274) refuses malformed markers with marker_invalid.
  WHY: The reviewer says there is no runtime failure and that this matches the design intent (source severity NIT).
- scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh:196-219 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new "reissue" verdict slot is added alongside the skip/refuse/verify/none slots, with no new env var and no renames.
  WHY: Nothing fails. The reviewer says backward compatibility is preserved (source severity NIT).
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:254-432 (solc_install.py implicit execution; .github/workflows/implement.yml:59) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The generated solc_install.py makes HTTPS fetches at image-build time, with host restriction, sha256 verification and no execution of the downloaded binaries, gated by the SANDBOX_SOLC_VERSIONS opt-in.
  WHY: Nothing fails. The reviewer says this adds no implicit execution beyond the trusted generated script (source severity NIT).

  WHY: Every later plan/clarify retry fails permanently and files plan_failed heal reports. The changelog remedy needs an operator. Fix: on a confirmed 404, emit a `::notice::` (`outcome=skipped reason=base_branch_deleted`) and return 0 with empty stdout, or follow the deleted branch as scripts/retarget_merged_base.sh does. Update reissue_merged_pr_base_branch_missing_refuses.json and the changelog.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:330-341 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The reissue path logs the same `outcome=routed` line for a merged PR's base branch, so `resolver_status=routed` contradicts the documented "verified PR head" meaning.
  WHY: Nothing breaks today (the check-triage guard at plan.yml lines 1906-1917 only acts on `ai:check-triage` issues), but the comment is stale. Fix: update the comment on lines 331-333.
- HARDENING: scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh (generated solc_install.py, fetch()): urlopen follows redirects before the `final.hostname` check. Fix: an HTTPRedirectHandler that rejects targets outside "https://binaries.soliditylang.org/" (6-8 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh line ~557: the free-text "Not Found" grep misclassifies errors as branch_missing. Fix: prefer `[ "${GH_API_RETRY_LAST_STATUS:-}" = "404" ]` as branch_exists() does at line 101 (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
